title: Implement player character with physics and controls
description: Create the player character as a pixel-art sprite (16x24 px). Implement gravity, jumping (with variable jump height based on key hold duration), horizontal movement with acceleration/deceleration, and ground detection. Support arrow keys and WASD. Add running animation frames (at least idle, run-left, run-right, jump). Implement coyote time (brief grace period to jump after leaving a platform edge). Dependencies: Task 1
